title_en: Get Double GTA$ and RP on Drag Races and 2X GTA$ on Auto Shop Client Jobs - Rockstar Games
excerpt_en: Time your upshifts precisely, avoid high-speed collisions, and power to victory in Drag Races, dishing out 2X GTA$ and RP this week — on top of the recently boosted payouts for these races as part of GTA Online: Agents of Sabotage.
